excludedControl.reason: Broad unnumbered Curva Grande sweep has no unambiguous diagram apex; a guessed point folds the registration. Do not invent a landmark just to fill all turn numbers.

registration.method: Piecewise affine using ten unambiguous manually identified turns, padded by global affine continuation
registration.limitation: Internal exact interpolation is not external accuracy. Schematic boundaries and source control uncertainty can produce tens-of-metres placement errors; local seat-view survey remains unavailable.

source.notes: Initial position on the green Prato stroke centreline nearest the official diagram P label, projected by distance into its registered ground patch with0.05m numerical inset. Glyph circles extend outside the stroke and are not physical seat coordinates. Not a surveyed seat or a visibility guarantee. No raycast-based location optimization; all ground remains freely selectable, and remembered user positions take precedence.

Organizer2026 map P stroke interpreted by ten manually identified turn controls and piecewise affine registration, with global affine continuation outside their hull. Schematic map, not cadastral boundary. Regional names distinguish geographic portions of the same P ticket, not separate ticket products. Known rendered road+0.75m and stand/building/pit/water+0.5m excluded. <=100m computational patches preserve continuous picking; boundary simplification0.1m; tiny <4m2 remnants omitted. Trees, screens and actual spectator density are not surveyed.

openingSource.notes: Official2026 grandstand map marks six green P/Circolare Prato strips; official2026 price tables separately list P/General Admission. Same ordinary admission family, separate from numbered grandstands and unnumbered GF terraces.

surfaceSource.notes: Ground follows regional GEDTM30 v1.2 at true vertical scale, <=8m mesh edges. Clearance0.04m and seated eye1.2m; no invented rows, berm heights or exaggerated terrain. Regional model cannot resolve local paths, fences, trees, earthworks or all sightline obstructions.

geometryReview.method: Registered source P stroke clipped against known road/stand/building/pit/water geometry. Independent finite eye/mesh, 3D ray and actual photograph checks remain required; plan-view clearance is not a full view guarantee.
